# guardium-data-protection Provider

Guardium Data Protection provider for managing GDP resources and deploying Edge components using native Kubernetes API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aws_access_key` (String, Sensitive) AWS access key ID
- `aws_profile` (String) AWS CLI profile name
- `aws_region` (String) AWS region for EKS cluster
- `aws_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) AWS secret access key
- `cm_url` (String) Central Manager URL for downloading edge bundles
- `eks_hostname_type` (String) EKS hostname type: private-dns or ip-address
- `eks_ssh_key_passphrase` (String, Sensitive) Passphrase for the EKS SSH key (if the key is passphrase-protected)
- `eks_ssh_key_path` (String) Path to SSH key for EKS worker nodes
- `eks_ssh_user` (String) SSH username for EKS worker nodes
- `host` (String) The Guardium Data Protection host
- `k3s_connect_timeout` (Number) SSH connection timeout in seconds for K3s operations. Defaults to 30.
- `k3s_server_alive_count` (Number) SSH keepalive count before disconnect for K3s operations. Defaults to 3.
- `k3s_server_alive_interval` (Number) SSH keepalive interval in seconds for K3s operations. Defaults to 10.
- `k3s_ssh_password` (String, Sensitive) SSH password for K3s nodes. Can also be set via K3S_SSH_PASSWORD environment variable.
- `k3s_ssh_user` (String) SSH username for K3s nodes. Can also be set via K3S_SSH_USER environment variable.
- `oauth_token` (String, Sensitive) OAuth token for authenticating with Central Manager
- `ocp_insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification for OpenShift API server (default: false)
- `ocp_password` (String, Sensitive) OpenShift password for OAuth authentication
- `ocp_server` (String) OpenShift API server URL (e.g., https://api.cluster.example.com:6443). When set with ocp_username/ocp_password or ocp_token, uses native OAuth instead of kubeconfig.
- `ocp_token` (String, Sensitive) OpenShift OAuth token (alternative to username/password, can be obtained via 'oc whoami -t')
- `ocp_username` (String) OpenShift username for OAuth authentication
- `platform` (String) Target platform: k3s, eks, or openshift
- `port` (String) The Guardium Data Protection port
- `rook_ceph_connect_timeout` (Number) SSH connection timeout in seconds for Rook-Ceph operations. Defaults to 30.
- `rook_ceph_server_alive_count` (Number) SSH keepalive count before disconnect for Rook-Ceph operations. Defaults to 3.
- `rook_ceph_server_alive_interval` (Number) SSH keepalive interval in seconds for Rook-Ceph operations. Defaults to 10.
- `rook_ceph_ssh_password` (String, Sensitive) SSH password for Rook-Ceph operations. Can also be set via ROOK_CEPH_SSH_PASSWORD environment variable.
- `rook_ceph_ssh_user` (String) SSH username for Rook-Ceph operations. Can also be set via ROOK_CEPH_SSH_USER environment variable.
- `ssh_key_path` (String) Path to SSH private key file
- `ssh_password` (String, Sensitive) SSH password for connecting to nodes
- `ssh_user` (String) SSH username for connecting to nodes
